_comment: Single source of truth for the demo's RLS personas. Loaded by cube/cube.js (as CUBEJS_PERSONAS_PATH) and by backend/personas.js. The browser only ever sends a persona id -- it never sends a territoryGroup or a SQL fragment. The expectedTotal fields are the verified ground-truth SUM(SalesAmount) figures from FactResellerSales, used by the frontend and by scripts/bootstrap.mjs's smoke test to assert RLS actually filtered the data.

personas.description: Not a real end user -- excluded from listPersonas() (backend/personas.js) for exactly that reason. The fixed identity Superset's stored Cube database connection authenticates as (see scripts/bootstrap.mjs and cube/cube.js's canSwitchSqlUser). territoryGroup is a value no real territory ever has, so this identity's own access_policy match returns zero rows -- any query that reaches Cube on this connection without an authorized __user switch fails closed to nothing, never to everything.
